neutral.EN: Looks clear now. That got rough for a minute.
neutral.TL: Mukhang malinaw na. Naging delikado sandali.

neutral.EN: Area is secure. Check yourselves for injuries.
neutral.TL: Ligtas na ang lugar. Tingnan niyo kung may mga sugat kayo.

neutral.EN: They're all down. Take a breath and reload.
neutral.TL: Tumba na silang lahat. Huminga at magkarga ng bala.

neutral.EN: Fight's over. Good work holding the line.
neutral.TL: Tapos na ang laban. Magandang pagpigil sa linya.

neutral.EN: Looks like the immediate threat is dealt with.
neutral.TL: Mukhang naasikaso na ang agarang banta.

neutral.EN: Clear. Everyone still in one piece?
neutral.TL: Malinaw. Buo pa ba ang lahat?

neutral.EN: Threat neutralized. Let's recover our stamina.
neutral.TL: Nalipol ang banta. Bawiin natin ang lakas natin.

neutral.EN: It's quiet again. Stay alert for stragglers.
neutral.TL: Tahimik na ulit. Magbantay sa mga naiwan.

neutral.EN: Combat is finished. Reload and bandage up.
neutral.TL: Tapos na ang bakbakan. Magkarga at magbenda.

neutral.EN: We held them off. Area appears clear.
neutral.TL: Naitaboy natin sila. Mukhang malinis na ang lugar.

warm.EN: We made it through! Is everyone okay?
warm.TL: Nakalusot tayo! Ayos lang ba ang lahat?

warm.EN: Thank goodness you're alive. That was terrifying.
warm.TL: Salamat sa Diyos at buhay ka. Napakatindi noon.

warm.EN: Great fighting, partner! I'm so glad we survived that.
warm.TL: Napakagaling mong lumaban, kasama! Masayang-masaya ako't nakaligtas tayo.

warm.EN: Come here, let me check you over for bites or scratches.
warm.TL: Halika rito, titingnan ko kung may kagat o gasgas ka.

warm.EN: We did it together. Nobody got left behind.
warm.TL: Nagawa natin nang magkasama. Walang naiwan sa atin.

warm.EN: Take a breath, friend. We held the line.
warm.TL: Huminga ka muna, kaibigan. Naipagtanggol natin ang pwesto.

warm.EN: I was worried for a second there, but you fought bravely.
warm.TL: Nag-alala ako nang sandali, pero buong tapang kang lumaban.

warm.EN: Proud to stand beside you in that fight. We're safe now.
warm.TL: Ipinagmamalaki kong tumabi sa 'yo sa laban. Ligtas na tayo ngayon.

warm.EN: Rest for a minute. You earned it after that mess.
warm.TL: Magpahinga ka muna. Karapat-dapat ka roon pagkatapos ng gulo.

warm.EN: All clear! Hugely relieved we're both standing.
warm.TL: Malinis na! Napakalaking ginhawa na nakatayo pa tayong pareho.

guarded.EN: Don't relax yet. Scan for stragglers.
guarded.TL: Huwag munang magpakampante. Maghanap ng mga naiwan.

guarded.EN: Down, but keep your weapon ready. More could be coming.
guarded.TL: Tumba na, pero ihanda ang armas. Baka may paparating pa.

guarded.EN: Check your perimeter before you start celebrating.
Check every corpse. Make sure they stay down.
guarded.TL: Tingnan ang bawat bangkay. Tiyaking hindi na gagalaw.

guarded.EN: Gunfire brings more of them. We need to be ready to move.
guarded.TL: Nakahahatak ng iba ang putok. Maging handa tayong umalis.

guarded.EN: Wipe your blade and reload immediately.
guarded.TL: Punasan ang talim at magkarga agad ng bala.

guarded.EN: Are you bitten? Answer me right now.
guarded.TL: Kinagat ka ba? Sagutin mo ako ngayon din.

guarded.EN: Threat is dead, but noise travels fast out here.
guarded.TL: Patay ang banta, pero mabilis kumalat ang ingay dito.

guarded.EN: Keep low. Don't silhouette yourself in the doorway.
guarded.TL: Yumuko ka. Huwag mong i-expose ang sarili mo sa pinto.

guarded.EN: Clear for now. Expect a second wave.
guarded.TL: Malinis sa ngayon. Maghanda sa pangalawang bugso.
